what_this_is_en: Every substance named on every line, read a second time and asked only that: not roles, not quantities, not whether it matters. `specific` names one substance you could draw; `generic` refers to a substance without naming one, and is counted apart because `the catalyst` is sometimes an anaphor and sometimes the finding.
verified_en: Every span below was checked to be a literal substring of the line it is filed under before this file was written. A span that is not on the line fails the build rather than reaching a reviewer.
how_read_en: Read in ten disjoint line ranges covering all 1344 lines, each range by a separate agent in a fresh context with no access to output/ and no sight of the A1 or A2 extraction. The readers are the same model family as the extraction and worked from the same vision transcription, so agreement between this list and the records is weaker evidence than it looks; disagreement is the signal.
